name: Oren
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Oren is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a son of Jerahmeel, a descendant of Judah through Perez and Hezron. He is only mentioned in the genealogies and has no known actions described in the Bible beyond his place in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Oren is listed as one of the sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron, in the genealogical record of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: The Lineage of Jerahmeel
keyEvents.description: Jerahmeel's descendants, including Oren, are recorded as part of the larger genealogy from Judah through Perez and Hezron.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy of the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: The broader lineage from Judah through his son Perez forms the foundation for many important biblical families, including the royal Davidic line.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Hezron
keyEvents.description: Hezron, Oren's grandfather, was a key patriarch in Judah's lineage, and his descendants played a role in Israel's history.
